headline: US forces conduct defensive strikes against Iran in Strait of Hormuz
summary: A US official stated that American forces carried out defensive strikes against missile launcher bases in Iran within the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Military escalations in the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital global petroleum transit routes, directly driving volatility in crude oil prices and shipping insurance costs.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: US military strikes in the Strait of Hormuz disrupt key crude oil shipping choke points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Military strikes in the critical Strait of Hormuz heighten fears of supply disruptions in global oil transit channels, causing sharp upward moves in crude prices.
